title: Google Lens Visual Search Scraper
description: Find Google Lens matches from public image URLs, including titles, sources, thumbnails, links, and prices. Submit several images per run to discover visually similar products or pages.

batch.title: Image URLs
batch.description: Public image URLs to use for visual search.
batch.valueDescription: url used to run this search.

schema.description: Public HTTPS URL for the image to search.
Optional text used to refine visual or product matches.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Find visual matches from public image URLs with titles, sources, thumbnails, links, and prices. Use results for product discovery and catalog research.
storeCopy.intro: Submit public image links to find similar pages and products. Rows include match titles, source labels, thumbnails, links, prices when present, and rank.
useCases: E-commerce teams can find comparable products from catalog photos.
Visual search specialists can map source pages and merchants for an image.
Product researchers can compare visual matches, prices, and thumbnails.
howToUse: Add one public image URL to `image_urls` for each search.
Set `q` or `type` to refine the search when supported.
Review matched source, image, link, and price fields.

faqs.question: Do all visual matches include a price?
faqs.answer: No. A price appears only when the matched result contains price information.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Website or merchant name associated with the visual match.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Product or page title associated with this Google Lens match.

fields.name: link
fields.description: Destination page URL for the visually similar result.

fields.name: thumbnail
fields.description: Preview image URL returned for the visual match.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Displayed product price and currency when Google Lens finds one.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Position of the visual match in the returned list, starting at 1.

fields.name: input_url
fields.description: Public image URL submitted to Google Lens for visual search.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this visual match was collected.
